label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Ciarán, right, here’s the full thing.

Logger: went over 8C at Sat 22:50, back under 8 at Sun 05:00, so 6 hrs 10 min out of range. Peak was 11.6C at 02:15 Sun. Min overnight Fri was 4.1C, normal. Alarm stays beeping until someone resets it, so it was still going when I found it at 07:55 this morning.

It was the door—wasn’t fully clicked shut. Box of Hartmann’s bags from Saturday’s delivery was stacked against it, and the seal is cracked bottom left so it needs a proper lean to catch. I had to lean on it with my hip this morning to get it to click. Saturday clinic finished late with the RTA collie and the delivery got put away in a rush at closing. That’s the sequence, not pointing at anyone—it’s the door and the seal.

Stock in it: 14 DHPPi, 9 lepto L4, 6 intranasal kennel cough, 3 rabies, 4 vials insulin, 2 cat flu/FeLV combos. Roughly €1,150 at cost.

Rang Munster Vet Supplies tech line at 08:40, spoke to Niamh, the pharmacist. She said quarantine everything, don’t use, email the logger CSV and batch numbers, they’ll check with the manufacturers and come back by Wednesday. She checked the manufacturer’s storage sheet for the insulin product we stock against the logger readings and cleared those four vials for use. So the insulin is usable. The vaccines are quarantined in a sealed bag labelled DO NOT USE in the lab fridge—checked it’s sitting at 5.2C and started a new temp sheet for it.

I wouldn’t bin anything until the supplier comes back. Most of these are probably fine but it’s not my call. So no vaccines are usable until Wednesday at the earliest.

Aoife—hold the three boosters this afternoon for now. If the supplier clears the stock, you can rebook them for Thurs/Fri, or we borrow from Carrigaline. The 10.30 puppy can stay moved to Wednesday.

What needs changing: the door seal needs replacing anyway—I think it was the box and the seal together. The logger is the old ThermaTrak one, only beeps locally, no text alerts, which is why it beeped all weekend with nobody here. New one with SMS alerts is about €180 from the supplier catalogue. And I’d add a lock-up check on the fridge door to the closing checklist so someone actually pulls it and confirms it’s clicked.

Can you OK the SMS logger and a new seal? I’ll have the CSV and batch numbers emailed to Niamh before 2 so you have them for your call.

Ruth
